title: AgentForge exchange.json
description: The neutral exchange record (ADR-0012) projected from run.json + gates.json for an external agentic app to monitor and, via a drive intent, request the run be driven. Composed read-only from RunState + GateState by exchange_record.build — never itself authoritative; run.json/gates.json remain the system of record. Also declares the single-source enum for an inbound drive intent's 'action' field, read by exchange.drive/adapter parsers so the enum can never fall out of step (SCHEMA_DRIVEN_VALIDATION).

schema_version.description: Schema version this file was written against.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this record was built.

objective.description: The /agentforge run objective, carried through verbatim.

current_stage.description: The run's active stage id, or null when the run is complete or escalated — mirrors run_state.RunState.current_stage.

stages.description: Stage id -> status ('pending'|'in_progress'|'complete'|'failed'), mirrors run_state.StageState.status for every STAGE_SEQUENCE entry.

gates.description: One entry per gate currently in gates.json.

artifact.description: Artifact path (or synthetic key, e.g. 'pr:<branch>') this gate protects.

blocked_on.description: Artifacts whose gate is pending AND type=='hard' — exactly what drive.apply_intent's fence refuses to advance past.

artifacts.description: All produced artifact paths across every stage, de-duplicated, in first-seen order.

driveIntent.description: One inbound drive intent an external agentic app submits (e.g. a GitHub Issue label/comment), parsed into exchange.adapter.DriveIntent. Not itself a top-level field of exchange.json — declared here as the single-source authority for the 'action' enum so a parser and the fence can never disagree about what a valid action is.

target.description: A stage id (for 'advance') or an artifact path (for gate-related actions).

raw_id.description: The originating external record id (e.g. a GitHub Issue number/URL), for traceability back to the source.
